question: Where should the seed mantras of the retinue deities be placed?
premises: The retinue deities possess seed mantras.
Each retinue deity has its own designated place.
Ritual placement requires assigning seeds to proper locations.
inference: The seed mantras of the retinue deities should be placed in their respective locations.
plain_english: One should place the seed mantras of the retinue deities in their own respective places.
